audience.statement: People who water compact indoor plants and want control near desks or shelves.
audience.testMethod: Compare click-through rate against a generic beauty shot.

motivator.statement: Avoid wetting the desk while keeping plant care quick.

painPoint.statement: Large droplets land beyond the plant.
painPoint.testMethod: Validate with five user interviews before treating as a claim.

useCase.statement: Misting a small fern beside a laptop.
useCase.testMethod: Use as a creative test scenario.

trend.statement: Clean split-frame problem/solution compositions may improve immediate comprehension.
trend.testMethod: Run as one test cell; do not label viral without measured evidence.

hook.promise: Show controlled mist beside a dry desk surface.

taste.direction: Bright editorial utility with a tactile, lived-in desk rather than a sterile catalogue scene.
taste.lighting: Soft window light from camera left with a narrow rim revealing the mist plume.
taste.photography: Crisp commercial still with realistic droplets and restrained depth of field.
antiGenericRules: Include a believable imperfect desk grain
Keep the mist plume physically tied to the nozzle

creative.scene: A small fern on a walnut desk beside a closed laptop; the fictional demo bottle appears at foreground right.
creative.composition: Diagonal product-to-fern sightline; dry desk surface remains visible below the mist; leave the upper-left safe area clear.
creative.camera: Eye-level three-quarter view, 50 mm equivalent, product label plane readable without distortion.
creative.subjectAction: A hand performs one trigger press; a narrow fine-mist plume travels toward the fern and nowhere else.
